description.p: Aux Command is a Linux-native remote operations workstation. It brings SSH, SFTP, FTP/FTPS, SSH tunnels, RDP, VNC, Mosh, Telnet, serial consoles and local shells together in one workspace without hiding the Linux tools you already trust.

ul.li: Real PTY terminals for SSH, Telnet and serial sessions
Graphical SFTP with drag-and-drop, inline editing and a resumable transfer queue
Local, remote and dynamic SSH tunnels with live status
Keyword highlighting for log triage and per-connection reachability
Encrypted credential vault, host-key verification and profile import/export

description.p: In the Flatpak version, RDP, VNC, Mosh and the network lookup tools use programs that are not part of the sandbox, so those features are limited there, and local shells open inside the sandbox rather than on the host. SSH, SFTP, FTP, tunnels, Telnet and serial work fully.

Linux-style terminal copy and paste, draggable and renamable tabs, a colour per connection, terminal zoom, RDP certificate confirmation and pinning, SFTP that honours OpenSSH known_hosts, safer paste and sync, and many fixes across tunnels, file transfer, workspaces and translations.

Terminal assist (OS detection, inline suggestions, autocorrect, dangerous-command guard), cross-session history search, multi-session command runner, session replay, live host stats, optional bring-your-own-endpoint AI assist, and a UI localized in nine languages.
Embedded RDP, SSH config Include parsing, multi-hop ProxyJump, log highlighting, connection health, and a redesigned interface.
